components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Transparent, green-bordered call-to-action button; the only filled-with-color-in-border control in the system.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: transparent; color: #000; border: 2px solid #76b900; padding: 11px 24px; border-radius: 2px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.5px; font-family: Archivo, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; transition: opacity 0.2s, transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.92; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; } .ds-btn-icon { display: inline-flex; }

components.name: KPI Card
components.description: The primary data-readout card: white surface, hairline border, colored 2px top stripe keyed to its role, hover-lift with the one shadow token.

components.css: .ds-kpi-card { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.12); border-radius: 2px; padding: 28px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; transition: border-color 0.25s, transform 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s; font-family: Archivo, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; } .ds-kpi-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); border-color: rgba(0,0,0,0.22); box-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); } .ds-kpi-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 2px; } .ds-kpi-green::before { background: #3f8500; } .ds-kpi-head { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #000; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-kpi-value { font-size: 32px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.5px; color: #000; } .ds-kpi-sub { font-size: 13px; color: #757575; margin-top: 6px; }

components.name: Quality Badge (Hook/Hold Rate)
components.description: The five-tier semantic quality ramp used throughout Hook Rate and Hold Rate views: Excellent/Very Strong/Good/Average/Weak mapped to green/cyan/purple/yellow-text/red.
components.html: Excellent Very Strong Good Average Weak
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 2px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; font-family: Archivo, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; } .ds-badge-excellent { background: rgba(63,133,0,0.1); color: #3f8500; border: 1px solid rgba(63,133,0,0.2); } .ds-badge-strong { background: rgba(0,70,164,0.1); color: #0046a4; border: 1px solid rgba(0,70,164,0.2); } .ds-badge-good { background: rgba(77,19,104,0.1); color: #4d1368; border: 1px solid rgba(77,19,104,0.2); } .ds-badge-average { background: rgba(239,145,0,0.1); color: #b35400; border: 1px solid rgba(239,145,0,0.2); } .ds-badge-weak { background: rgba(229,32,32,0.1); color: #e52020; border: 1px solid rgba(229,32,32,0.2); }

components.name: Status Dot
components.description: 8px circular status indicator with five fixed color roles, used in tables/lists without an accompanying text label.
components.css: .ds-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; display: inline-block; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-dot-red { background: #e52020; } .ds-dot-orange { background: #df6500; } .ds-dot-idle { background: #a7a7a7; } .ds-dot-green { background: #3f8500; } .ds-dot-blue { background: #0046a4; }

components.name: Rank Badge
components.description: Leaderboard rank chip; rank 1 gets a distinct 2px accent-green border and green text to mark the top performer.
components.css: .ds-rank-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 18px; height: 18px; padding: 0 4px; border-radius: 2px; border: 1px solid #5e5e5e; background: #fff; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: #000; font-family: Archivo, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; } .ds-rank-1 { border-color: #76b900; border-width: 2px; color: #3f8500; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Black-chrome sidebar item; the active state is the sidebar's only use of color, a 1px accent-green border with no fill.
components.css: .ds-sidebar-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 11px 12px; border-radius: 2px; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 400; color: #898989; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; border: 1px solid transparent; font-family: Archivo, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; background: #000; } .ds-sidebar-item:hover { color: #a7a7a7; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); } .ds-sidebar-item.ds-active { background: transparent; color: #FFFFFF; font-weight: 700; border: 1px solid #76b900; } .ds-sidebar-item.ds-active:hover { background: rgba(118,185,0,0.08); color: #FFFFFF; }

components.name: Select Input
components.description: Flat, hairline-bordered select used in the tabs bar (month picker); focus shifts border to solid accent green with no glow.
components.css: .ds-select { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.22); color: #000; padding: 9px 16px; border-radius: 2px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; outline: none; font-family: Archivo, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; transition: border-color 0.2s, background 0.2s; } .ds-select:hover { background: #F5F5F5; } .ds-select:focus { border-color: #76b900; }

narrative.overview:
The dashboard reads as a precision measuring instrument, not a decorative product page: true-black chrome (sidebar, header, tabs bar) frames true-white data surfaces (cards, tables, charts), with a single NVIDIA-green (#76b900) accent doing all the signaling — active nav item, focused input, primary-action border. This directly replaces an earlier dark-glass, radial-glow, heavily-rounded theme; that incumbent look is confirmed rejected by the shipped code (no gradients, no blur, no radius above 2px anywhere in the stylesheet). The Meta-brand-token reference (design.hagicode.com/designs/nvidia) was the pinned starting point, but the shipped system is not a literal copy of it: two tokens were deliberately darkened for on-white text contrast, and the type scale settled on a font the spec didn't call for.

Density is high and functional — three different audiences (contributors, the content manager, leadership) read tables, KPI cards, and calendars packed at a small type scale, and the shipped system accepted that density rather than inflating it for legibility theater. Color is otherwise reserved: outside the semantic quality-tier badges, the only saturated color on any screen is the one green accent.
keyCharacteristics: True-black chrome / true-white data-surface split, never mixed on the same panel.
One accent (#76b900) reserved for active/focus/primary-border states only.
A five-tier semantic color ramp (green/cyan/purple/orange-text/red) is the one deliberate exception to "one accent" — it carries real Hook Rate/Hold Rate quality meaning, not decoration.
Flat by default: no gradients, no blur; the one shadow token appears only on hover-lift and open modals.
2px corner radius everywhere; no exceptions found in the shipped CSS.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: #76b900 marks exactly one thing per screen: what is active, focused, or primary. It never appears as a text color on a white surface — text-on-white uses #4d7a00 instead.

rules.name: The Two-Gray Compromise Rule
rules.body: The white-surface system has only two grays, not three: --text2 and --text3 are both #757575. This was a deliberate accessibility trade — the NVIDIA reference's literal Gray-400 (#898989) fails WCAG AA as text on white, and no compliant lighter alternative was substituted, so the third tier collapsed into the second. Do not reintroduce a distinct --text3 value without confirming it clears AA contrast on white.

rules.name: The Semantic-Only Saturation Rule
rules.body: Outside the five-tier Hook/Hold Rate quality ramp and the KPI-card top-accent stripes, no color renders except black, white, gray, and the one green accent.

rules.name: The Dense-Operate Rule
rules.body: This is an Operate-mode instrument, not an editorial page: functional labels (table headers, filter chips, calendar weekday abbreviations, form field labels) run 9–11.5px throughout, well below comfortable-reading size. This was a disclosed, deliberate density decision, not an oversight.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: No card, panel, or button carries a shadow in its default state. Shadow is always a response to open/hover, never a resting decoration.

dos: Do keep the accent (#76b900) reserved for active/focus/primary-border states; use #4d7a00 (Accent Text) whenever the brand hue needs to render as legible text on a white surface.
Do keep the 2px radius and 1px hairline-border convention on every new card, button, chip, or input; there is no larger radius anywhere in the shipped system.

Do use the five-tier quality ramp (green/cyan/purple/yellow-text/red) whenever a new surface needs to communicate a graded quality/performance signal — it is the one sanctioned exception to the single-accent rule because it carries real data meaning.
Do treat the interaction shadow (0 0 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)) as a state response only: hover-lift or an open modal, never a resting card or button.
Do render every icon as an inline SVG from the shared 24x24, stroke="currentColor", stroke-width="1.75", round-cap/join set — this is now the only icon system in the file.
donts: Don't introduce a third distinct gray tier for text-on-white without checking it clears WCAG AA contrast — the system currently has only two (#757575) precisely because the spec's literal third gray (#898989) failed that check.
Don't reintroduce gradients, glassmorphism blur, or radii above 2px — these were the explicitly rejected incumbent visual system and none remain in the shipped CSS.

Don't treat the 9–11.5px functional label sizes (table headers, filter chips, calendar weekday labels) as a defect to silently "fix" by bumping type size on a new surface; it's a disclosed, accepted density characteristic of this specific Operate-mode dashboard.

Don't treat the plain Unicode checkmark (✓) still used in a handful of transient save/copy toast textContent strings as the icon convention — the actual convention is the inline-SVG set; the checkmark is a known, disclosed leftover in low-visibility transient text, not a pattern to extend.
